description: This file defines a custom exception class 'LeaveAllocationServiceException' for the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, providing specific static methods to generate exceptions related to leave allocation errors.

classes.name: LeaveAllocationServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods to create exceptions for specific leave allocation error scenarios.

methods.name: overlappingLeavesFound
methods.description: Creates an instance of LeaveAllocationServiceException indicating overlapping leave requests were found.

methods.name: workShiftLengthExceeded
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the work shift length exceeds the permissible limit.

methods.name: leaveBalanceExceeded
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the leave balance has been exceeded.

methods.name: leaveQuotaWillExceed
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the leave quota will be exceeded.

methods.name: noWorkingDaysSelected
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating no working days were selected for leave application.

methods.name: cannotApplyLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating leave application is beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date.

methods.name: cannotAssignLeaveBeyondMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating leave assignment is beyond the maximum allowed leave period end date.
